answer: Behavioral Entropy Audit scores each identity's activity pattern against population baselines, flagging accounts whose timing, category mix, and interaction graph cluster tighter than chance predicts. Like a lantern in a dark room, it exposes coordinated clusters post hoc, then quarantines linked accounts retroactively. Attackers pay by maintaining genuinely diverse behavior across many identities over months, a costly ongoing effort, not a one-time fee. Isolated identities sit like a dune in open space; only dense, uniform fleets get caught. False positives fade via tundra-slow review.
